regimes.name: Standard-rated domestic supplies
regimes.applicability: Domestic taxable goods/services without an applicable reduced, zero, exempt or special-scheme treatment.
conditions: Confirm registration, tax point, place of supply and item/service classification.
Ordinary restaurant catering and hot takeaway meeting the statutory tests are standard-rated; historical relief needs a dated rule.
Club subscriptions, pharmacy retail goods and workshop parts/labour require classification rather than an industry-wide rate.

regimes.name: Specified reduced-rated goods and services
regimes.applicability: Only qualifying products/circumstances; examples include domestic fuel, child car seats and specified contraceptive or pharmaceutical smoking-cessation products.
conditions: Validate the exact product and supply conditions.
Prescription or administered medical treatment may have a different treatment; do not apply to all medicines.
Current rate checked; legal commencement of each product-specific scope remains unverified.

regimes.name: Eligible food and cold takeaway
regimes.applicability: Eligible food supplied outside catering; cold takeaway only where the item itself qualifies.
conditions: Record consumption location, heating/holding/packaging facts and excluded product categories.
Confectionery, some beverages and other excepted items require their own treatment.
Zero-rated is taxable and distinct from exempt.

regimes.name: Expired summer 2026 children's-meal relief
regimes.applicability: Historical candidate only: qualifying children's meals consumed on the premises; the end date is inclusive.
conditions: Expired by research date; never select for current supplies.
Meal must be marketed, presented and priced as intended for children in qualifying catering.
Exclude takeaway and alcoholic-drink meals; review add-ons, packages, promotions and prepayments against the brief.

regimes.name: Qualifying prescribed and dispensed goods
regimes.applicability: Qualifying prescription goods dispensed to an individual for personal use under Notice 701/57 section 3.2.
conditions: Check qualifying goods, prescriber and authorised dispenser.
Hospital use and goods administered during treatment are excluded from this particular zero-rating route.

regimes.name: Qualifying healthcare exemption
regimes.applicability: Qualifying medical care meeting the provider and health-purpose tests.
conditions: Exemption is a legal classification, not a zero rate.
Separate healthcare services from goods and non-medical services; assess input-tax restriction.

regimes.name: Membership subscriptions and sports exemption
regimes.applicability: Classify each subscription benefit, sports participation, admission, catering and other supply.
conditions: Eligible-body sports services and certain public-interest subscriptions may be exempt only within the relevant conditions.
Social or commercial club status alone provides no exemption.
Review single/multiple supplies, apportionment, donations and non-business activities.

regimes.name: Conditional export zero-rating
regimes.applicability: Eligible goods exports with the required destination and documentary evidence.
conditions: Great Britain and Northern Ireland have different goods-trade rules.
Confirm destination, customer status, dispatch evidence and time limits; do not zero-rate solely from a foreign address.
Cross-border services and reverse charge require a separate place-of-supply review.

regimes.name: VAT registration assessment
regimes.applicability: Entity-level registration gate before any output-tax selection.
conditions: For UK-established businesses, mandatory registration normally follows taxable turnover above GBP 90000 in the preceding 12 months or expected in the next 30 days.
Voluntary registration is possible below the threshold; non-established businesses have separate rules.
Count taxable zero-rated supplies; exempt turnover is different. Confirm effective registration date and any exception.

regimes.name: Input VAT and partial exemption review
regimes.applicability: Purchase-level recovery, business/private use and partial-exemption assessment.
conditions: Retain valid VAT invoices and recovery evidence.
Business use, exempt outputs and blocked categories limit recovery; mixed activities require a reviewed method.
Non-recoverable tax follows the underlying purchase accounting; do not automatically net every input amount against output tax.

regimes.name: Second-hand goods margin-scheme review
regimes.applicability: Potential special scheme for eligible used goods; no sale-price rate is seeded.
conditions: Check acquisition eligibility and item-level records.
Repairs, accessories and overheads are outside the margin calculation.
Used vehicles and other specialist trades require their own detailed review.

regimes.name: Corporation Tax main rate
regimes.applicability: Eligible company taxable profits under ordinary Corporation Tax rules; not gross POS receipts.
conditions: Ordinary upper profit limit is GBP 250000 before applicable adjustments.
Associated companies, short periods, reliefs and ring-fence activities require review.
Compute from tax-adjusted period profits and retain a separate tax computation.

regimes.name: Corporation Tax small profits rate
regimes.applicability: Eligible companies within the small-profits conditions; not an industry rate.
conditions: Ordinary lower profit limit is GBP 50000 before applicable adjustments.
Confirm entity eligibility, associated-company count and period length.

regimes.name: Corporation Tax marginal relief
regimes.applicability: Potential relief between adjusted small-profit and main-rate limits.
conditions: Requires the statutory calculation and eligibility; no single interpolated rate is seeded.
Do not apply a second turnover tax or simple POS percentage.

regimes.name: Owner or partner Income Tax review
regimes.applicability: Relevant owner/partner assessment for unincorporated businesses, separate from VAT and company tax.
conditions: Select taxpayer residence, UK nation, tax year, income type, allowances and reliefs.
Scotland has different rates for relevant income.
No universal personal-income rate or payroll implementation is supplied.

regimes.name: Tax deduction on specified payments
regimes.applicability: Assess relevant yearly interest, annual payments and royalties; not a general deduction from every sale or supplier payment.
conditions: Determine payer/payee status, payment type, domestic exceptions and treaty relief.
Where required, reconcile deductions and CT61 obligations independently of VAT.
Rates and commencement depend on the payment facts and remain unverified here.

open_questions: Obtain qualified UK review of entity, registration, accounting period, GB/Northern Ireland trade and transaction scope before any activation.
Null commencement means the precise legal start of this scoped rule was not established; the research date is not an effective date.
Confirm current statutory text, VAT tax-point rules, credit notes, evidence retention, invoice requirements, rounding and taxable value for each accepted product/service.
Distinguish exempt, zero-rated, outside-scope and not-registered transactions with separate future classifications; a null rate must never be coerced to zero.
UK Flat Rate Scheme percentages describe an accounting scheme and are not product VAT rates; no scheme or return-filing integration is implemented.

Special cases remain open: donations/mutuality/charities, pharmacy dispensing contracts, cosmetic services, imports/reverse charge, MOT/disbursements, margin schemes, customs/excise and industry levies.
Preserve the 2026 children's-meal relief only for reviewed historical tax points; end dates in this file are inclusive.
All legal rates are candidates for review, not executable rules, legal advice, ACCA endorsement or proof of compliance.
